bagPolicy.summary: Bags, purses and clutches up to 5" x 9" x 2" are allowed. Backpacks of any size are not permitted.
allowed: Bags, purses and clutches up to 5" x 9" x 2"
Clear bags within the same size limit
bagPolicy.note: Diaper or medical bags up to 12" x 12" x 12" are allowed after additional screening. All bags, including clear bags, are inspected. There is no bag check.

parking.summary: Official venue guidance provides event parking information.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Orpheum Theatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages are not allowed at The Orpheum Theatre, and neither are alcohol, glass bottles, or metal cans.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating and restrooms are available. Accessible seating is at the rear of the Orchestra Level for guests with accessible needs and one companion, so tell Ticketmaster you need it when ordering. If you need accessible seating without an accessible ticket, go to the Box Office when you arrive.

reEntry.summary: Official venue guidance permits re-entry only under the procedure described on the linked page, such as retaining a ticket, scan, stamp, or wristband.
